sentences.en: The density of tubers was greatest in the parietal lobes, and tubers were more frequent in the cingulate gyrus than expected.

sentences.en: Anterior cingulate pathology has been implicated in emotional disorders such as depression and schizophrenia.

sentences.en: The most common operation involves removing a section of the brain called the cingulate cortex.
